# name: set-cofinite-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Hausdorff.cofinite_not_hausdorff
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['ℕ', 'inferInstance'], True, "have key : ∀ (X : Type) [inst1 : Infinite X], T1Space (CofiniteTopology X) ∧ ¬ T2Space (CofiniteTopology X) := by
  intro X inst1
  refine ⟨inferInstance, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne X
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hxU, hyV, hUV⟩ := @t2_separation (CofiniteTopology X) _ h
    (CofiniteTopology.of x) (CofiniteTopology.of y) (CofiniteTopology.of.injective.ne hxy)
  rw [CofiniteTopology.isOpen_iff'] at hU hV
  rcases hU with rfl | hU
  · exact hxU
  rcases hV with rfl | hV
  · exact hyV
  have : (Uᶜ ∪ Vᶜ).Finite := hU.union hV
  rw [← compl_inter, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 hUV, compl_empty] at this
  exact Set.infinite_univ this
exact @key (ℕ) (inferInstance)"),
    (['ℤ', 'inferInstance'], False, "have key : ∀ (X : Type) [inst1 : Infinite X], T1Space (CofiniteTopology X) ∧ ¬ T2Space (CofiniteTopology X) := by
  intro X inst1
  refine ⟨inferInstance, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne X
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hxU, hyV, hUV⟩ := @t2_separation (CofiniteTopology X) _ h
    (CofiniteTopology.of x) (CofiniteTopology.of y) (CofiniteTopology.of.injective.ne hxy)
  rw [CofiniteTopology.isOpen_iff'] at hU hV
  rcases hU with rfl | hU
  · exact hxU
  rcases hV with rfl | hV
  · exact hyV
  have : (Uᶜ ∪ Vᶜ).Finite := hU.union hV
  rw [← compl_inter, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 hUV, compl_empty] at this
  exact Set.infinite_univ this
exact @key (ℤ) (inferInstance)"),
    (['ℚ', 'inferInstance'], False, "have key : ∀ (X : Type) [inst1 : Infinite X], T1Space (CofiniteTopology X) ∧ ¬ T2Space (CofiniteTopology X) := by
  intro X inst1
  refine ⟨inferInstance, fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne X
  obtain ⟨U, V, hU, hV, hxU, hyV, hUV⟩ := @t2_separation (CofiniteTopology X) _ h
    (CofiniteTopology.of x) (CofiniteTopology.of y) (CofiniteTopology.of.injective.ne hxy)
  rw [CofiniteTopology.isOpen_iff'] at hU hV
  rcases hU with rfl | hU
  · exact hxU
  rcases hV with rfl | hV
  · exact hyV
  have : (Uᶜ ∪ Vᶜ).Finite := hU.union hV
  rw [← compl_inter, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 hUV, compl_empty] at this
  exact Set.infinite_univ this
exact @key (ℚ) (inferInstance)"),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
